sn35.61:1.4: cakkhuñca paṭicca rūpe ca uppajjati cakkhuviññāṇaṃ. tiṇṇaṃ saṅgati phasso.
sn35.61:1.6: evaṃ passaṃ bhikkhave, sutavā ariyasāvako cakkhusmimpi nibbindati, rūpesupi nibbindati, cakkhuviññāṇepi nibbindati, cakkhusamphassepi nibbindati, vedanāyapi nibbindati.
sn35.61:1.7: nibbindaṃ virajjati. virāgā vimuccati. vimokkhā “pariyādinnaṃ me upādāna”nti pajānāti, …pe…
sn35.61:1.8: jivhaṃ ca paṭicca rase ca uppajjati jivhāviññāṇaṃ. tiṇṇaṃ saṅgati phasso. phassapaccayā vedanā. evaṃ passaṃ bhikkhave, sutavā ariyasāvako jivhāyapi nibbindati, rasesupi nibbindati, jivhāviññāṇepi nibbindati, jivhāsamphassepi nibbindati, vedanāyapi nibbindati. nibbindaṃ virajjati. virāgā vimuccati. vimokkhā “pariyādinnaṃ me upādāna”nti pajānāti …pe…
sn35.61:1.9: manañca paṭicca dhamme ca uppajjati manoviññāṇaṃ. tiṇṇaṃ saṅgati phasso.
sn35.61:1.11: evaṃ passaṃ, bhikkhave, sutavā ariyasāvako manasmimpi nibbindati, dhammesupi nibbindati, manoviññāṇepi nibbindati, manosamphassepi nibbindati, vedanāyapi nibbindati.
sn35.61:1.12: nibbindaṃ virajjati, virāgā vimuccati, vimokkhā “pariyādinnaṃ me upādāna”nti pajānāti.
